summary: Verified LEADING scoreboard visibility fix across light theme, dark theme (regression), and doubles+light (combined-name regression). All three scenarios pass. Light-theme leading card now uses light amber background (#FEF3E2) with dark text (#475569 name, #0F172A score) and dark amber LEADING pill (#8D5B2A) — all clearly visible. Dark-theme leading card retains previous dark amber-brown bg (#2A2117) with cream muted name, white score, and gold LEADING pill. Doubles combined name 'Alice & Charlie' is fully readable in the light leading card without overflow.
critical_code_review_comments: index.tsx is 93 lines but each line is extremely long (some >5000 chars). File organization is fine, but readability suffers due to single-line component definitions.

The Score component correctly uses `light ? scoreLeaderLight : scoreLeader` variant selection and `[styles.leading, light && styles.leadingLight]` for the LEADING pill — the reported bug is fully addressed.
seed_data_creation: None (frontend-only, localStorage cleared before each scenario)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix for light-theme LEADING scoreboard visibility is verified working. Key selectors: [data-testid='theme-toggle'], [data-testid='input-Player 1 · North'], [data-testid='proceed-to-toss'], [data-testid='toss-team-a'], [data-testid='start-board'], [data-testid='complete-board']. rca_of_issue: Original bug: scoreLeader style hardcoded backgroundColor:'#2a2117' which overrode lightCard's white bg in light theme, resulting in dark name/score text on dark bg = invisible. Fix (verified): added scoreLeaderLight (bg #FEF3E2, amber border) and leadingLight (color #8D5B2A) styles; Score component conditionally applies them based on the `light` prop. All three test scenarios (light leading, dark leading regression, doubles light leading) pass with correct computed styles.
